125B total / 6B active plus 51B n-gram embedding and 4B MTP (180B on disk). No official build fits one node with KV room: Ollama q4_K_M is 120 GB, NVFP4 133 GB, FP8 186 GB. This is the 93.7 GB unsloth UD-IQ4_XS, imported into Ollama 0.34.2 with the library's own renderer/parser (qwen3.8 / qwen3.5), num_ctx 65536, ~98 GB resident. Vision is a 400: the imported GGUF has no projector, so this is the build, not the model (the checkpoint ships a vision encoder). An extra array-argument probe (a todo tool whose `todos` is an array of objects, offered next to two other tools, 5 trials) returned a real array 5/5, never a stringified list. RELIABILITY: the llama-server runner aborted 7 times in its first ~20 requests with a CUDA 'internal operation failed' in the cuBLAS matmul path, each an HTTP 500; it did not recur in the ~40 requests after.
